primary.scope: Only the fixed 28 curved nodes; preselected global integer-sp PGF paths in shortest zero-to-five-decimal TeX points that recover each original sp; fixed six-decimal glyph matrices and semantic CSS root. Exact original-primary observations, no extra margin.
primary.rounding: Foreground mean rounded upward to 1e-9 channel units; every other limit is the independent observation in that exact region/view/background.

nativePdf.scope: Only this independently registered fixture, representation, white background, region and view. No inherited or candidate-derived allowance.
nativePdf.rounding: Foreground mean rounded upward to 1e-9; other maxima are the exact independent observation. Absent edges are never allowed for measured-edge regions.
nativePdf.inkRule: Exact integer RGB sums of 255 minus every white-backed sample in the fixed native-page crops; one preselected independent short-TeX-point PGF representation per view, no margin, other representation extrema or candidate input.

nativeUnitContract.coordinates: Global integer scaled-point PGF soft path
nativeUnitContract.decimals: First zero-to-five-place TeX-point decimal recovering the original integer sp; half-away-from-zero rounding
nativeUnitContract.glyphs: Original outlined glyphs with native six-decimal CSS matrices
nativeUnitContract.root: Native picture and ink union, semantic six-decimal CSS root

originalPdf.scope: Only this independently registered fixture, representation, white background, region and view. No inherited or candidate-derived allowance.
originalPdf.rounding: Foreground mean rounded upward to 1e-9; other maxima are the exact independent observation. Absent edges are never allowed for measured-edge regions.
originalPdf.inkRule: Exact integer RGB sums of 255 minus each white-backed sample in fixed native-page crops; one preselected independent native-semantic-six-decimal representation per view, no margin or candidate input.
